purpose: Formalize domain-agnostic Worldshepherd usefulness routing so internet discoveries are retained for any material capability improvement, while keeping Glob-number evidentiary weight as an independent classification axis.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, technical record, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or other information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it can materially improve any project capability, even when it contributes zero physics evidence and zero Glob evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Mirrors, alternate landing pages and derivative summaries of the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: A raw number occurrence may still be useful as metadata, security intelligence, a partner lead, a validation method, a manufacturing precedent, a software/data-engineering pattern or a negative control; those uses do not convert the matched digits into Glob evidence.

utility_routing_policy.principle: Worldshepherd usefulness and Glob evidentiary weight are orthogonal axes.
utility_routing_policy.retention_rule: Retain a substantive source when it provides a reusable method, dataset, architecture, failure mode, benchmark, manufacturing process, security signal, business/partner signal, validation pattern, operational precedent or other concrete capability input in any listed domain.
utility_routing_policy.evidence_independence: Glob evidence continues to use P2/P1/G1/M1/N0 or gated status independently of utility routing. A source may be highly valuable to Worldshepherd and still have zero Glob evidentiary weight.

information_updates.finding: Useful discoveries are no longer implicitly physics-centric. The research pipeline now evaluates technical, operational, computational, security, manufacturing, commercial and organizational utility on equal footing with physics utility.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Utility routing does not imply scientific validation or Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: Each substantive source should carry two independent labels: a Worldshepherd utility destination and a Glob evidence class/status. This prevents valuable non-physics sources from being discarded and prevents useful engineering/business material from being misread as numerical evidence.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The two axes must remain independently auditable.

next_actions: Continue internet scanning across the full 208-state union while retaining any substantive source with reusable Worldshepherd value, not only physics sources.

Expand source routing to software, cybersecurity, AI/ML, manufacturing, operations, commercialization, partner intelligence, supply chain and governance whenever the discovered item materially supports those areas.
Continue independent same-system topology and relational scans for physical P1/P2 candidates without allowing non-physics utility to inflate Glob evidence.
Maintain fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls for all numerical-evidence promotion.
